gaps.name: Control row
gaps.reason: No catalogue component lays out a search field and segmented controls in one wrapping row that can stick to the top.

gaps.name: Two unequal columns
gaps.reason: The grid gives equal columns. Text beside a preview needs two columns of different widths that stack on a phone.

gaps.name: Example
gaps.reason: One example on a component page: its title, a do or a don't with an icon and a word, its reason, the preview and the markup.

gaps.name: Site footer
gaps.reason: The catalogue has no footer for a site.

gaps.name: Preview frame
gaps.reason: The inline frame that holds one gallery example in its own document, so its theme and width can change apart from the page.

gaps.name: Site header
gaps.reason: The app header is for an app with one title and a tray. A documentation site needs a brand mark and a row of links to its pages.

gaps.name: Hero
gaps.reason: No catalogue component lays a headline beside a live preview.

gaps.name: Theme matrix
gaps.reason: Four previews of one example, one for each theme and mode.

gaps.name: Checker output
gaps.reason: The result of a check: a badge, the exit code and the printed output.

gaps.name: Point
gaps.reason: One short point: a heading, a sentence and an optional link.

gaps.name: Points
gaps.reason: Short points under a rule, laid out by how many there are. The card is not used, so that a row of them is not a grid of identical cards.

gaps.name: Running text
gaps.reason: The catalogue has no component for paragraphs and lists of running text.

gaps.name: Page section
gaps.reason: The catalogue has no band that divides a long page into sections with a rule between them.

gaps.name: Skip link
gaps.reason: The catalogue has no skip link. It is a button from the catalogue, placed off screen until it is focused.

gaps.name: Specimen
gaps.reason: One item of the specimen list: a live preview, the component name as a link, its purpose and its status.

gaps.name: Specimen list
gaps.reason: The catalogue is a list of uniform items, as the rules ask, but each item shows a live preview, which the list component has no slot for.

gaps.name: Preview stage
gaps.reason: No catalogue component frames a live preview of another component with a bar above and a caption below.

gaps.name: Step
gaps.reason: One numbered step of the setup guide.

gaps.name: Numbered steps
gaps.reason: The stepper shows progress through a form. The setup guide needs numbered steps that each hold text and code.

gaps.name: Colour swatch
gaps.reason: No catalogue component draws the value of a colour token. The swatch is an image of the value, with the value beside it as text.

gaps.name: Token value
gaps.reason: A token value in mono type with its swatch.

gaps.name: Type roles
gaps.reason: The catalogue sets type inside its components. A page of prose needs an eyebrow, a display line, a heading, a lead and a note, each on the type scale.

gaps.name: Page column
gaps.reason: The container is one reading column. A marketing page needs the wide column with page gutters.
